title: Like the blessings of Bakhty Han given to Shamans dancing around Ülgen's birch tree welcoming the worthy to boundaries of spirit world riding on souls
summary: Like the blessings of Bakhty Han given to Shamans dancing around Ülgen's birch tree welcoming the worthy to boundaries of spirit world riding on souls stolen from steeds #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Like the blessings of Bakhty Han
given to Shamans dancing
around Ülgen's birch tree
welcoming the worthy
to boundaries of
spirit world
riding on souls
stolen
from steeds
#poetryport
